{{Vanilla|Sponge}}
{{Infobox auto}}
A '''sponge''' soaks up water. [[Matcha Flavoured]] dries wet sponges in an [[oven]] or [[Mud Kiln|mud kiln]].

== Obtaining ==
{{Recipes}}
A wet sponge dries in an oven or mud kiln in 2.5 seconds; the vanilla furnace recipe is removed.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/kiln/sponge.json}}</ref><ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/pack.mcmeta}}</ref>
